violations.description: The Docker image defined in the Dockerfile is never built or validated in CI.
violations.evidence: .gitlab-ci.yml has a single `test` stage that runs `pip install tox` and `tox` (lines 7-8). No job runs `docker build`, and the GitHub workflow only does labelling.
violations.recommendation: Add a GitLab CI job (e.g. a build stage using docker:dind or kaniko) that builds the image and runs a short smoke test of the container on every pipeline.

violations.description: The container CMD runs `python -m ledger`, but the package has no __main__ module, so the image cannot start.
violations.evidence: Dockerfile line 8 is `CMD ["python", "-m", "ledger"]`. The only files in the ledger package are ledger/__init__.py (empty, 0B) and ledger/db.py; there is no ledger/__main__.py.
violations.recommendation: Add ledger/__main__.py with the real service entrypoint, or change CMD to point at an existing executable module or script.
